input: The tags of the stored original record of a clip and its source frame rate; with the read feature, the project content target and a clip id (read-only through qnc-content-store).
output: The start timecode of the clip at its nominal source rate and HH:MM:SS:FF labels. Camera XML LTC (Sony LtcChangeTable) is the only source when the record has camera XML; the timecode of the one Ingest probe is read only for a clip without camera XML; none gives --:--:--:--. A camera LTC at a lower rate (halfStep) is scaled to the source rate. Drop-frame is not supported and gives no start. User rules 2026-09-25: the source clip sets the rate; export and the flat program playlist use these original timecodes; the program may keep its own internal timecode.
specification: QNC_v5 qnc-app/src/frame_time.rs frame_to_timecode and qnc-app/src/qnc_source_dock.rs (IN/OUT/Trajanje as HH:MM:SS:FF); the start from the camera record is a user rule over v5, which counted from the first frame of the clip.
